decision_rationale: The previous 45-minute safety-adjusted gate was an operational cap, not a scientific failure. X6B reduced the raw projection to about 53.4 minutes and the 1.5x safety projection to about 80.1 minutes with zero accelerator/CPU sign rejections. A resumable chunked execution is therefore authorized with a 100-minute safety-adjusted admission cap.

execution.chunk_independence: each triplane base regime is an independent C0 root; chunking must not change per-root semantics
execution.persistent_checkpoint: one compressed NPZ per completed chunk plus atomic progress JSON
execution.resume_rule: on restart, completed chunks whose hashes and root ranges match the manifest are skipped
execution.cpu_worker_autotune: repeat host-local X6B autotune before CUDA initialization; selected pool remains authoritative
execution.semantic_gate: repeat frozen16 exact state match and require cpu_rejected_count=0

final_merge_gates: exactly 103823 unique root indices covered once
aggregate terminal/unresolved/proposal/evaluation counts equal sum of chunk receipts
all artifact hashes recorded before completion marker
claim_boundary: Research-only C0 micro2 full-domain measurement. No product authority, Knight witness, Stage13 pass, shipping directed-rounding certificate, or global continuous zero-set completeness claim.
